description: Compile, diagnose, and fix IEEEtran LaTeX manuscripts for JSAC, TWC, TCOM, WCL, CL, and related IEEE journals: documentclass options, BibTeX/IEEEtran bibliography, undefined citations/refs, overfull hboxes, figure/table placement, algorithm/equation numbering, Index Terms, EDICS, biographies, and final PDF checks. Use this when the user asks to "compile IEEEtran", "fix LaTeX", "overfull hbox", "undefined references", "BibTeX error", "IEEE LaTeX", "latex编译", "参考文献不显示", or prepare a manuscript PDF for IEEE submission. Use latex-compile when available for raw build execution; this skill adds IEEE-specific diagnosis.
